exposure: Term PROM vs matched controls with intact membranes
outcome: Latency period for PROM and PPROM
cohort: 182 cases with prelabour ruptured membranes and 514 controls with term gestational age and intact membranes
finding: Prematurity and prolonged rupture of membranes are two important reasons of neonatal morbidity in PROM.
mod_finding: Rates of Caesarean section are not increased by inducing patients with ROM, and is comparable between patients of PPROM and PROM.
